name: Bugaboo Butterfly 2 car seat adapter
seatBrandsSupported: Maxi-Cosi interface car seats. Bugaboo lists: Clek Liing; Maxi-Cosi Coral XP / Mico XP Max / Mico 30 / Mico Luxe+; Nuna Pipa series (Pipa, Lite, Lite LX, RX, Aire, Aire RX, Urbn); Cybex Cloud Q / Aton M / Aton 2 / Cloud G Lux with SensorSafe; and Bugaboo Turtle Air / Turtle One by Nuna. Confirms the Clek Liing + Maxi-Cosi footprint.

status.clekNote: Clek Liing is explicitly listed by Bugaboo as compatible with this adapter.

install.pieces: pair of click-and-go adapter brackets (left + right)
install.notes: Bugaboo click-and-go attachment system: brackets clip onto the Butterfly 2 frame and the infant car seat clicks into the adapters; no tools required.

notes: Adapter for the CURRENT Bugaboo Butterfly 2 only — distinct part from the original Butterfly's 100045001 adapter; the two are not interchangeable. $69.95 MSRP; currently available on bugaboo.com DTC, but sold out / on preorder (arriving early-to-late August) at several third-party retailers (Swaddles Baby, Traveling Tikes) as of 2026-07-05. Clek Liing explicitly listed as a compatible seat.
